newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine farmers begin sunflower harvesting.
newsitem.headline: Argentine farmers begin sunflower harvesting.

text.p: Argentine farmers had begun harvesting sunflowers in Chaco, Santiago del Estero, Entre Rios and Santa Fe by January 24, the Agriculture Secretariat said in its weekly crop report Thursday.

There have been some isolated outbreaks of sclerotinia in sunflowers in northern Buenos Aires and western Buenos Aires. There have been numerous outbreaks of Rio Cuarto disease in northeast Buenos Aires, northern La Pampa and southern Santa Fe. There have also been less serious outbreaks of the virus in eastern Cordoba and northern Buenos Aires. Soybeans need rain in central-north Santa Fe.
